13 item types have no priced BOM source (HPS, PEK, PEK V2, PRV, Stem Elbow, Diverter Valve, Elbow Connector, Female Connector/Lattu, M3-series pre-filter housing/spun, M3/M3 Pro concealed membrane, M3/M3 Pro TDS sensor input, Mini UPS, Back Panel Retrofit) -- priced Rs 0 and flagged in Revisit Detail below, not silently omitted. 49 of 60 Rest/Filter/Other items had Sept-26 price carried forward from Aug-26.
